description: Generalist RL agent trained across the six worldwide starter decks (ST-1 Gaia Red, ST-2 Cocytus Blue, ST-3 Heaven's Yellow, ST-4 Giga Green, ST-5 Machine Black, ST-6 Venomous Violet). One LSTM policy learns to pilot all six AUDITED-OK starter archetypes; opponents are sampled from the same starter-deck pool. Cloud-run entrypoint: python tools/run_training_job.py /app/jobs/cloud_starter_decks.json
